overview: The Central African Republic is a landlocked country in the heart of Africa. Its capital and largest city is Bangui. It became independent from France in 1960, and Sango and French are its official languages. The country has rich resources such as diamonds and gold, but years of conflict have left it one of the poorest countries in the world.

geography.text: Most of the country is a wide, rolling plateau covered in savanna. Rainforest grows in the south-west, and the north-east is drier. The Ubangi river, which forms much of the southern border, flows into the Congo.
